title: Breathe
title_override: Breathe | Dreamy Chillwave Music to Relax, Focus & Unwind (Full Song) | Quiet Money
theme: slowing down and learning to breathe when life and money feel loud
opening_line: “Breathe” is a full-length original song by Quiet Money: dreamy chillwave with a wordless female vocal, made to put on and let the night slow down.
cta_line: If it slowed your night down, send it to one friend who needs to breathe and who is ready to leave the rat race.
description: A 3 minute 27 second journey from a still, misty opening to a soaring final peak and a quiet fade. Put it on for focus, a late-night wind-down, a walk or a long drive. Visuals are a film of fourteen surreal scenes drawn to follow the music.
who_for: Who is it for? Anyone who wants calm background music for studying, working, winding down or sleeping, and people who feel the weight of money stress and need a few minutes to breathe.
disclosure: AI disclosure: the music was made with an AI music tool, the visuals were made with AI image tools, and the spoken welcome is an AI-generated voice. Not financial advice.
comment_line: Where did this one take you? Tell us below, and send it to one friend who needs to breathe. We read every comment.
